title: Procedural Tentacle Animation with Collision Avoidance
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a procedural tentacle animation system with collision avoidance between multiple tentacles and interactive obstacles.

## Scene Setup
- Dark underwater-themed scene with background color #0a1628.
- PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 8, 18) looking at origin.
- Ambient light (color #334466, intensity 0.4) and two point lights: one at (10, 15, 10) color #4488ff intensity 1.2, one at (-10, 10, -5) color #22ffaa intensity 0.8.
- A flat circular base (radius 2, color #1a3355) at y=0 representing the creature body.
- Render 6 tentacles, each composed of 12 segments (bones). Each tentacle is a skinned mesh cylinder chain. Tentacles are evenly spaced around the base perimeter (60 degrees apart). Each segment length is 0.8 units, segment radius 0.15 tapering to 0.04 at the tip.
- Place 3 spherical obstacles in the scene at positions (4, 3, 0), (-3, 4, 2), (0, 2, -4) with radius 1.2 each, colored #ff4444 with 50% transparency.

## Procedural Animation
- Each tentacle animates using a sine-wave based procedural system. Each bone rotates on X and Z axes using: angle = sin(time * frequency + segmentIndex * phaseOffset) * amplitude. Default frequency=1.5, phaseOffset=0.4, amplitude=0.15 radians.
- Tentacles should appear to sway organically. Each tentacle has a slightly different base frequency (tentacle index * 0.1 added to base frequency).

## Collision Avoidance
- Implement sphere-based collision detection for each tentacle segment tip against each obstacle sphere. Use a collision radius of 0.5 for each segment point.
- When a segment would penetrate an obstacle, push it away along the vector from obstacle center to segment position. The repulsion force decays with distance: force = max(0, (collisionThreshold - distance) / collisionThreshold) * repulsionStrength. Default repulsionStrength = 2.0.
- Also implement tentacle-to-tentacle avoidance: each segment checks against segments of other tentacles within radius 0.6. Apply mutual repulsion.
- Track total active collisions count and total repulsion force magnitude each frame.

## User Interactions
- KEYBOARD 'Space': Toggle pause/resume of the animation. When paused, all tentacle motion freezes.
- KEYBOARD '1'-'6': Select a tentacle by index (0-5). Selected tentacle glows brighter (emissive color #00ff88).
- KEYBOARD 'ArrowUp'/'ArrowDown': Increase/decrease the amplitude of the selected tentacle by 0.02 per press. Clamp to [0.02, 0.5].
- KEYBOARD 'ArrowLeft'/'ArrowRight': Increase/decrease the frequency of the selected tentacle by 0.1 per press. Clamp to [0.3, 5.0].
- KEYBOARD 'R': Reset all tentacles to default parameters (amplitude=0.15, frequency=1.5 + index*0.1).
- KEYBOARD 'O': Toggle obstacle visibility on/off. When hidden, collision avoidance against obstacles is also disabled.
- MOUSE click on canvas: Raycast to find clicked obstacle. If an obstacle is clicked, enter drag mode. While mouse is held, obstacle follows mouse projected onto y=obstacle.y plane. Release to drop.
- DOM BUTTON 'Add Obstacle': Add a new obstacle sphere at a random position within bounds x:[-5,5], y:[1,6], z:[-5,5] with radius 1.0.
- DOM BUTTON 'Remove Last': Remove the most recently added obstacle (only user-added ones, not the original 3).
- DOM BUTTON 'Reset View': Reset camera to initial position and lookAt origin.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left HUD panel showing: selected tentacle index, its current amplitude (2 decimals), its current frequency (2 decimals), animation paused state, total obstacle count, active collisions this frame, total repulsion force magnitude (2 decimals), FPS counter.
- Three buttons at bottom-center: 'Add Obstacle', 'Remove Last', 'Reset View'.

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose the following on window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame:
- `tentacleCount` (number): always 6
- `segmentsPerTentacle` (number): always 12
- `selectedTentacle` (number): index 0-5 of selected tentacle, default 0
- `isPaused` (boolean): animation pause state, default false
- `obstaclesVisible` (boolean): obstacle visibility, default true
- `obstacleCount` (number): total obstacle count
- `tentacleParams` (array of 6 objects): each {amplitude: number, frequency: number}
- `activeCollisions` (number): count of active segment-obstacle collisions this frame
- `totalRepulsionForce` (number): sum of all repulsion force magnitudes this frame
- `tentacleTipPositions` (array of 6 objects): each {x, y, z} world position of the last segment tip
- `obstaclePositions` (array of objects): each {x, y, z} for every obstacle
- `frameCount` (number): incremented each animation frame
- `fps` (number): current frames per second
- `dragActive` (boolean): whether an obstacle is currently being dragged
- `cameraPosition` (object): {x, y, z} of camera
- `lastResetFrame` (number): frameCount at which 'R' was last pressed, default 0
physics_constraints: Collision avoidance must prevent tentacle segments from penetrating obstacle spheres. Repulsion force must be proportional to penetration depth. Tentacle-to-tentacle avoidance must prevent overlapping segments. All position values must be finite (no NaN/Infinity). Tentacle tip positions must remain within a reasonable bounding sphere of radius 15 from origin. Amplitude and frequency clamping must be strictly enforced.
